ABOUT ME

Research grounded in environmental challenges

More about my background

I work at the intersection of environmental research, water systems and practical engineering. My interests connect emerging pollutants, urban stormwater, climate risk and sustainable WASH infrastructure.

I am Md. Tanvir Ahmmed, an environmental and water researcher and civil engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I am pursuing a full-time M.Sc. (Engg.) in Disaster Risk Reduction Engineering at Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET).

Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET)University of Asia Pacific (UAP)

RESEARCH FOCUS

Questions that connect water, people & place.

Microplastics & Emerging Pollutants

Abundance, characterization, transport, environmental distribution and ecological risk of emerging contaminants.

Urban Stormwater Pollution

Pollutant pathways, drainage networks, stormwater discharges and impacts on receiving water bodies.

Water Quality & River Pollution

Environmental monitoring, surface-water quality, spatial assessment and pollution characterization.

Wastewater Treatment & WASH

Treatment systems, water supply, sanitation, public health and sustainable WASH infrastructure.

Climate & Disaster Risk

Climate hazards, environmental risk, extreme events and climate-resilient systems.

Sustainable Infrastructure

Resource-efficient engineering, sustainable materials and environmentally responsible infrastructure.
